Any torus polynomial that approximates ANDn within 20n error requires degree ω(log(n)). Organization of the Paper. We introduce some notation and preliminary statements required for our results in Section 2. Section 3 is dedicated to proving Theorem 2, and its extension to nested block symmetry. In Section 4, we describe our proposed approach for making progress on the constant degree hypothesis by improving lower bounds for torus polynomials approximating AND. Finally, in Section 5, we prove Theorem 3 about symmetric torus polynomials approximating periodic functions. 2 Preliminaries We start by formally defining the notion of symmetry for circuits.
